title: El Nabil has become the number-one perfume brand in marketing
htmlContent:
The perfume brand El Nabil has continued to grow and surprise its customers since it was created in 2011. Its fragrances are now an integral part of the everyday life of several million consumers worldwide. Luxurious, prestigious, qualitative, gorgeous.

El Nabil is, first and foremost, a story. And not just any, but that of its founder, who was an honest seeker of the essence before giving life to his empire. He negotiates raw materials of exceptional quality through his travels. This explains why we find many fragrances worldwide in the brand's products: Oud wood from Cambodia, ambergris from East Africa, Jasmine from the Maghreb, Myrrh resin from Ethiopia, patchouli from Indonesia, rose from Bulgaria, vanilla from Madagascar, etc.

Today, many experts are part of the adventure - including renowned French perfumers - located in the city of perfume in Grasse - whose contribution allows El Nabil to offer new, highly qualitative olfactory experiences every day.

El Nabil has become the number 1 French oriental perfume brand by marketing luxury perfumes at an affordable price, making them accessible to everyone, as evidenced by its advertising slogan: "Luxury for everyone."

El Nabil brand products are sold in more than 50 countries across Europe, America, Africa, and Asia. Some successful references have already sold several million bottles.

The brand is constantly evolving by regularly offering new original products. Indeed, beyond its famous classic perfumes, El Nabil innovates with Capilla perfumes for children, Room Fresheners, luxury car sprays, dressing perfumes, pocket perfumes, beard and hair care serums, and many other new products to discover!

The El Nabil brand provides its customers with 100% IFRA (International Fragrance Association) certified products. The brand's products registered on the European portal thus meet the strictest standards in the interests of transparency and excellence for its customers worldwide.
